20261122-physics-m2-1.title: Ema konekta rezistensia 6 Ω ho
20261122-physics-m2-1.goal: Apply principles of Ema konekta rezistensia 6 Ω ho to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-m2-1.material: [Análize sirkuitu avansada] Ema konekta rezistensia 6 Ω ho 3 Ω iha paralelu no depois konekta ba fonte 12 V. Korente totál neʼebé sulin iha sirkuitu hotu mak boot hira?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Análize sirkuitu avansada] Ema konekta rezistensia 6 Ω ho 3 Ω iha paralelu no depois konekta ba fonte 12 V. Korente totál neʼebé sulin iha sirkuitu hotu mak boot hira?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.explain: Rezistensia kombinada iha paralelu mak $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Korente totál mak $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Rezistensia kombinada iha konesaun paralelu: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, nune'e R = 2 Ω.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Kalkula korente totál I = V / R = 12 / 2.

20261122-physics-m2-2.topic: Termu atu rai bé manas ba
20261122-physics-m2-2.goal: Apply principles of Termu atu rai bé manas ba to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-m2-2.material: Termu atu rai bé manas ba tempu naruk iha dinding rua ho ‘vakuun’ iha entre no parte laran ‘hasai pratu’. Pár ida nebé loos hatudu dalan transferénsia manas nebé sira bloke?
20261122-physics-m2-2.thinking.0: Termu atu rai bé manas ba
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Termu atu rai bé manas ba tempu naruk iha dinding rua ho ‘vakuun’ iha entre no parte laran ‘hasai pratu’. Pár ida nebé loos hatudu dalan transferénsia manas nebé sira bloke?
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Kamada vakuun la iha meiu, tanba nee bloke totalmente transferénsia manas husi kondusaun no konveksaun, no dinding pratu nebé kintal reflete radiasaun termál iha forma onda infravermelhu ba laran no prevene lakon manas.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Vakuun la iha matéria, tanba nee prevene kondusaun no konveksaun liuhosi matéria.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Pratu reflete radiasaun termál, nebé mak onda eletromagnétiku (infravermelhu).
